terms.descEn: One full day on Mars (24 hours and 39 minutes — just a bit longer than an Earth day!).
terms.descUz: Marsdagi bir to'liq kun (24 soat 39 daqiqa — Yer kunidan biroz uzunroq!).

terms.descEn: A giant burst of energy and particles from the Sun. Outside Earth, it can hurt astronauts and electronics!
terms.descUz: Quyoshdan otiladigan ulkan energiya va zarrachalar oqimi. Yerdan tashqarida astronavtlarga xavf soladi!

terms.descEn: Heavy walls (water tanks, plastic, or Moon/Mars dirt) or magnetic fields that block dangerous space rays.
terms.descUz: Xavfli kosmik nurlarni to'suvchi himoya devorlari (suv baklari, plastik, Oy/Mars tuprog'i) yoki magnit qalqon.

terms.descEn: Radio messages travel at light speed: Moon takes 1.3s, Mars takes ~12 minutes—so you cannot wait for Earth!
terms.descUz: Radio signal yorug'lik tezligida uchadi: Oygacha 1.3s, Marsgacha ~12 daqiqa — favqulodda holatda Yerni kutib bo'lmaydi!

terms.descEn: Growing plants using water and nutrients instead of soil—just like NASA's Veggie garden on the Space Station.
terms.descUz: O'simliklarni tuproqsiz, suv va ozuqa eritmasida o'stirish — Xalqaro Kosmik Stansiyadagi NASA Veggie bog'i kabi.
